 "explanation": "The unit responds to the faces of furry, small-to-medium carnivores with upright pointed ears and whiskers, mainly foxes, red pandas and domestic cats. It responds more weakly to related furry animals such as lynx, fluffy small dogs and a hamster.",
 "evidence": "The top images are a fox (10), a red panda (10) and several cats (9), all close-up furry faces with pointed ears. Lower ranks (7-8) extend to a lynx, a sheltie, a papillon and a hamster, all sharing the fur, ear and whisker face pattern.",
 "missing_data": "Activations on non-furry animals, on furry animals with rounded ears such as bears, and on body-only crops without faces would show whether the unit codes for cat/fox faces specifically or for fur texture with pointed ears in general.",
 "confidence": 0.7}
